Brr's Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream

The most delicious homemade vanilla ice cream recipe. Also serves as a great base recipe for building additional flavors of ice cream.

Prep 15 min
Cook 25 min
Yield 1 Quarts
Ice Cream

Ingredients

Directions

  1. 1

    Mix Ingredients

    Whisk all the ingredients together in a bowl. Don't whisk too quickly, you don't want to add a lot of air to the mixture.

  2. 2

    Add to ice cream maker

    Pour the ingredient mixture into your ice cream maker while it is running. Run the mixer until the ice cream thickens up, about 20-30min, depending on the size of your ice cream maker and how much ice cream you're making.
